Tree seed maker:Through gene induced division technology, 10 tree seeds can proliferate to 35 after one day, which needs one battery to supply energy.﻿﻿
树木种子培育器：通过基因诱导分裂技术使10个树木种子在1天后增殖为35个,需要1个电池供能。

Resin extractor:It takes one day to consume 25 mutation tree seeds and extract 5 resin of corresponding trees, which needs one battery to supply energy.
树脂榨取机：每消耗25个变异树木种子，榨取5份对应树木的汁液，需要1个电池供能，耗时1天。

It is suggested to cooperate with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102]Official - Industrialization for PFM.
[/url]建议配合[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102]工业机器官方PFM版本[/url]使用。
